# Vendored libraries

Committed so the site renders with no network.

| File | Package | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| diagrams.js | mermaid, markmap-lib, markmap-view, and their dependencies, bundled with esbuild | mermaid 11.4.1, markmap-lib 0.18.12, markmap-view 0.18.12 |
| fonts/*.woff2 | @fontsource/newsreader, @fontsource/plus-jakarta-sans, @fontsource/jetbrains-mono | latin subsets, weights used by site.css |

Font files are the SIL Open Font License builds shipped by Fontsource. The diagram bundle is the MIT-licensed upstream packages.
